name: VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight 2026
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Hanoi, Vietnam, held on November 29, 2026, organised by VnExpress/FPT Online.
ai_summary: The VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight 2026 is a night road race in Hanoi, Vietnam, organised by VnExpress/FPT Online, with Sunday 29 November 2026 listed as race day and race kits handed out on 27 and 28 November. It offers four distances: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. In 2025 the marathon started at 12.05am on the listed race day, so runners gathered on the Saturday night; it started on Quang Trung street by Thien Quang Lake and finished on Tran Nhan Tong walking street.

core_facts.venue: Tran Nhan Tong walking street (finish); 2025 start on Quang Trung street by Thien Quang Lake

pros: Cool night racing: 14°C to 16°C through the 2025 marathon
Almost the whole course lit with white light in 2025
Flat, bridge-free half marathon through central Hanoi and the Old Quarter
Aid about every 2 km on the marathon, with water, electrolyte drink and fruit
Finisher windbreaker for marathoners, T-shirt for half marathoners, medal for everyone
cons: Overnight schedule: the 2025 marathon started at 12.05am and the half at 2am
The marathon crosses two Red River bridges, with gradients and strong wind
Marathon limit of 6 hours 15, with four checkpoints and aid stations that close on schedule
No refunds, and bibs cannot be transferred without the organiser's permission

faqs.question: When is the VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight 2026 race?
faqs.answer: The organiser lists Sunday 29 November 2026 as race day, with race kit collection on 27 and 28 November. It is a night race: in 2025 the marathon started at 12.05am on the listed race day, the 10 km at 1am, the 5 km at 1.30am and the half marathon at 2am. The 2026 start times have not been published.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: This race offers four distance categories: a full marathon (42.195km), a half marathon (21.1km), a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range allows participants of varying experience levels and fitness goals to choose a distance that suits their training and ability.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is in central Hanoi, beside Thong Nhat Park. In 2025 the start was on Quang Trung street by Thien Quang Lake and the finish on Tran Nhan Tong walking street, opposite the park's main gate; the two are close together. The organiser's 2026 page gives Tran Nhan Tong walking street as the event venue.
